issue.name: SQL injection
issue.issueBackground: SQL injection arises when user-controllable data is incorporated into database queries.
issue.issueDetail: The format parameter appears to be vulnerable to SQL injection. The payload ' OR '1'='1 was submitted and the response differed materially from the base response, and a 12 second delay was observed when a time-based payload was submitted.
issue.remediationBackground: Use parameterized queries for all database access.
issue.vulnerabilityClassifications: CWE-89: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command

requestresponse.request: GET /api/v1/reports/export?format=csv'+OR+'1'='1 HTTP/1.1 Host: vulnerable-demo.test Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.PLACEHOLDER.SIGNATURE

issue.name: Cross-site scripting (reflected)
issue.issueBackground: Reflected cross-site scripting arises when data is copied from a request into the response without encoding.
issue.issueDetail: The value of the q request parameter is copied into the HTML document as plain text between tags. The payload was echoed unmodified.
issue.vulnerabilityClassifications: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation

issue.name: Frameable response (potential clickjacking)
issue.issueBackground: If a page does not set a suitable X-Frame-Options or Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors header, it may be framed by third-party sites.
issue.issueDetail: The response does not prevent framing. This page is a static terms-of-service document with no forms, no authenticated state, and no state-changing actions.
issue.vulnerabilityClassifications: CWE-1021: Improper Restriction of Rendered UI Layers or Frames

issue.name: HTTP Host header injection
issue.issueBackground: Applications that trust the Host header may be vulnerable to cache poisoning or password-reset poisoning.
issue.issueDetail: The Host header was reflected in an absolute URL in the response. The affected resource is a static, unauthenticated SVG asset served from a CDN edge; no email, redirect, or cache key is derived from the header on this path.
issue.vulnerabilityClassifications: CWE-644: Improper Neutralization of HTTP Headers

issue.name: Strict transport security not enforced
issue.issueBackground: HSTS instructs browsers to interact with the site over HTTPS only.
issue.issueDetail: The application does not set a Strict-Transport-Security response header.
